- In consensus-specs Gloas, `NewPayloadRequest` is a [ProgressiveContainer](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L988).
- However, for ere-guests (used by zk-boost), it is a plain [SSZContainer](https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/blob/main/crates/stateless-validator-common/src/guest/input/new_payload_request.rs#L236-L242) (aka NO `#[ssz(progressive_container)]` attribute) .

==> `hash_tree_root(new_payload_request)` mismatches.
